lines.text: Tramyard dispatch. Marked status noted. Check the public Curfew warning before travelling to the Core.
Tramyard dispatch. Clan affiliation noted. Check the current gate and convoy terms at their counters.
Tramyard dispatch. Expedition receipt available for inspection. Self-attribution remains unverified.
Your record carries an interruption. Keep the actual interval with the manifest. An apology is not an explanation.
Your copy has nine years of channel headers. The log names Ferrymen recipients. The older headers do not authenticate their own origin.
Your records carry the matching consignment IDs. Compare the allocation with the delivery. Keep both copies.
Your convoy arrives without a recorded loss. Dispatch rates it amber. A safe arrival does not tell you what sets that rating.
Tramyard dispatch. Departures and routes are posted at the terminal. Kestrel wishes you a long commute.
Wake designation confirmed at Tramyard dispatch. Your lease record and your departure board are separate records.
